_comment: Lantai (Flare for Notion). Bundle com.hexastral.lantai. LOCALE SCOPE: 4 languages (en-US, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja). CN App Store is out of scope. Device icon label = bare Lantai. Do not use Orchid Terrace as the English name. CN marketing pages should not lead with 兰台.

en-US.title: Lantai
en-US.subtitle: Flare for Notion
en-US.promotionalText: Zero-edit Shortcuts into your Notion databases. Capture notes, inbox, links, and habits — AI ledger comes with Pro.
en-US.description:
Lantai (Flare for Notion) turns a verified Shortcuts workflow into an iOS app: connect Notion, pick a template, run one fixed-name shortcut. Your Notion database stays the source of truth — we store configs and quotas, not your rows.

WHAT IT IS

• Journal, inbox, link capture, and habit templates
• One shortcut named Lantai — no three-place renaming
• Optional AI ledger (subscription) in a later release

WHAT IT IS NOT

• Not a Notion charts SaaS
• Not a replacement for your Notion workspace
• Not available on the China App Store

Published by UseONE, LLC. Privacy and support: lantai.hexastral.com
